Rae Summers: Quick heads-up  several EU trial signups are reporting their activation status stuck at 'indexing'. I exported a list (~53 tenants). We need a short customer note, standard credit, and a plan for any renewal-risk accounts.

Owen Patel: Infra snapshot: small burst of downstream 5xxs caused retry amplification and a temporary consumer lag on the index writer. We applied a retry cap and increased consumer parallelism at 1818183000. Expect backlog to clear in ~30-45m. No data loss seen.

Marta Iverson: Draft customer copy (concise):

Marta Iverson: "Hello  we're sorry for the interruption. A subset of EU trials are seeing delayed activations while we clear an indexing backlog. We've applied fixes and expect service to normalize within 1 hour. Impacted trials will receive a $175 account credit automatically. To request prioritized assistance, book a 1:1: https://cal.redwood.ai/cs-officehours

We'll follow up with an RCA after the incident. — Redwood CS"

Rae Summers: Agree on $175 standard for trials <6 months. Manual backfills only for high-touch/enterprise on request. I'll flag any >$10k ARR accounts to AEs.

Owen Patel: Deploy link: https://deploys.redwood.ai/roll/retry-cap-921  success @1818183222. Queue progress: 40% @12m, 84% @32m.

CS Bot: Incident INC-5019 recorded  affected_count=53  status=mitigated  office hours attached.

Marta Iverson: Sending first wave to affected customers now (email + in-app). Subject: "Service update: temporary activation stalls for some EU trials". Includes booking link and credit note.

Owen Patel: Full drain at 1818185400. No corruption detected. We'll schedule GC tuning and a consumer-lag alert in the postmortem.

Rae Summers: Timeline: 1) customer note (sent) 2) status page update when drain=100% 3) RCA + renewal-risk comms within 24h 4) credits applied + quick feedback survey within 48h. I'll coordinate AE outreach. Thanks team. :pray:
